newsitem.title: USA: WMX says court denies injunction vs tender.
newsitem.headline: WMX says court denies injunction vs tender.

text.p: WMX Technologies Inc said Tuesday that the Court of Chancery in and for New Castle County, Delaware, refused to grant a preliminary injunction against WMX's completion of its "dutch auction" tender offer.
The company said the injunction had been sought in a class-action suit against it alleging non-disclosures of information in the company's offer to buy shares from shareholders.
In denying the request, the court "declined to find that the offer omitted material information as alleged in the lawsuit," a WMX statement said.
The company said it is continuing its offer, which is scheduled to expire April 28.
